title: Diagnosis is not a policy: a state-transition audit of caoability-conditioned test-time inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.25566v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time actions can satisfy retrieval, state-realization, program-consistency, or rendering objectives without correcting an answer. Test-time Error Response and Realizability Audit (TERRA) is an evaluation/auditing protocol, not a new inference algorithm. It uses a unified decomposition of intervention outcomes into applicability, target-state realization, endpoint translation, harm, and resource/inference cost. Paired comparisons fix the incoming state and evaluation conditions; cross-model analyses vary the receiving configuration. translated_title: 诊断不是策略：能力条件化测试时推理的状态转换审计
translated_abstract: 测试时动作可以在不纠正答案的情况下满足检索、状态实现、程序一致性或渲染等目标。测试时错误响应与可实现性审计（TERRA）是一种评估/审计协议，而非新的推理算法。它将干预结果统一分解为适用性、目标状态实现、端点转换、危害以及资源/推理成本五个维度。配对比较固定传入状态和评估条件；跨模型分析则改变接收配置。可执行金融推理实验得出三个发现：相同的上下文扩展可能损害一种配置却有益于另一种配置；充足的证据并不能确保正确性，因为不同配置在证据到答案的转换能力上存在差异；诊断余量——即基于理想化诊断信息可达到的、相对于实测基线的准确率提升空间——加上局部一致性并不能确保实际……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TERRA审计协议，将测试时干预结果分解为适用性、状态实现、端点转换、危害和成本五个维度，并通过可执行金融推理实验证明诊断信息本身并不构成有效策略——诊断余量与局部一致性均不能保证实际的性能提升。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TERRA, an auditing protocol that decomposes test-time intervention outcomes into applicability, state realization, endpoint translation, harm, and cost, demonstrating through executable financial reasoning experiments that diagnosis alone is not a policy—diagnostic headroom and local consistency do not ensure practical performance gains.
